authoring.purpose: Canonical catalog of static UX signatures. The runner (audit-ux-code.cjs) is a generic engine; all detection knowledge lives here.
authoring.canonicalIds: UX-001..UX-008 are the historical signatures documented in .agents/skills/code-level-ux-auditor/SKILL.md. Never renumber them. New rules append from UX-009.

severities.ERROR: Breaks core functionality on touch devices. Fails the audit even without --strict.
severities.WARNING: Degrades UX, correctness or performance. Fails only with --strict.

checkSemantics.line: Substring matchers. The rule fires when ANY is present in the candidate line.
checkSemantics.alsoLine: When present, at least one of these must ALSO appear in the same candidate line.
checkSemantics.unlessLine: Suppress the finding when ANY is present in the same line.
checkSemantics.unlessNearby: Suppress the finding when ANY is present within +/- window lines of the candidate line.
checkSemantics.nearby: Fire only when at least one of these is present within +/- window lines of the candidate line.
checkSemantics.needsContent: Fire only when at least one of these exists somewhere in the file.
checkSemantics.unlessContent: Disable the whole rule when ANY of these exists somewhere in the file.
checkSemantics.unlessFile: Disable the whole rule when the file path contains ANY of these substrings.
checkSemantics.requires.deps: Fire only when the dependency exists in the target package.json. Omit for stack-agnostic rules. Rules with no dependency gate run everywhere.
checkSemantics.window: Line radius used by nearby / unlessNearby. Defaults to 6.

authoring.suppression: Inline '// ux-audit-ignore' disables every rule on that line. '// ux-audit-ignore UX-004' disables only that rule. Project-level opt-out lives in .uxaudit.json (disableRules / exclude).

rules.title: Regional decimal comma blocker (input[type=number])
rules.signature: <input type="number"> used to capture monetary amounts or balances.
rules.impact: On LATAM mobile keyboards the native numeric pad often exposes only ',' and disables '.', while HTML5 type="number" rejects ',' in WebKit/Blink, yielding an empty value or a silent error.
rules.fix: Replace with inputMode="decimal" plus locale-aware format/parse helpers.
rules.message: type="number" input breaks regional decimal commas on mobile. Use inputMode="decimal" with a locale-aware parser.

rules.title: Physical keyboard shortcuts leaking into touch layouts
rules.signature: <kbd> chips, the command glyph or 'Ctrl+' strings rendered without responsive hiding.
rules.impact: Smartphones have no physical keyboard or Command key, so these elements pollute mobile headers and action bars.
rules.fix: Wrap the shortcut in 'hidden sm:inline-flex' or gate it behind a useIsMobile() branch.
rules.message: Physical keyboard shortcut rendered without a responsive hiding class such as 'hidden sm:inline-flex'.

rules.title: Drag gesture colliding with a scroll container
rules.signature: <Reorder.Group> or drag="y" mounted inside an overflow-y-auto container without scroll compensation.
rules.impact: The mobile browser reads vertical movement as native scroll intent and fires pointercancel, freezing the drag halfway. Prior scroll also desynchronises coordinate math, making items jump.
rules.fix: Use native Pointer Events with setPointerCapture, GPU-only transforms, parent scroll detection and edge auto-scroll. Always keep accessible move up/down controls.
rules.message: Drag/reorder element without setPointerCapture compensation. Verify it is not nested inside an overflow-y-auto container.

rules.title: Temporal localisation leak (month/day names without locale)
rules.signature: format(date, "MMM yyyy") or format(date, "EEEE") without a locale argument.
rules.impact: Produces mixed-language UI such as "January 2026" inside an otherwise localised product.
rules.fix: Always import the locale and pass it: format(date, 'MMMM yyyy', { locale: activeLocale }).
rules.message: date-fns format() with month/day names but no locale argument. Pass { locale: activeLocale }.

rules.title: Autocapitalise / autocorrect trap on identity inputs
rules.signature: <input type="email"> without autoCapitalize="none" and value normalisation.
rules.impact: iOS/Android keyboards force an uppercase first letter or append a trailing space after autofill, producing recurring invalid-credentials errors.
rules.fix: Add inputMode="email" autoCapitalize="none" autoCorrect="off" spellCheck={false} and normalise with .trim().toLowerCase().
rules.message: Email input without autoCapitalize="none" / autoCorrect="off". Causes login failures on mobile keyboards.

rules.title: Fixed bottom UI occluding scrollable content
rules.signature: Main scroll views padded with pb-16 / pb-20 / pb-24 while a fixed bottom bar or FAB is present, instead of pb-32 plus safe-area-inset-bottom.
rules.impact: The last rows of a list are physically hidden behind the bottom navigation or FAB, making them unreachable.
rules.fix: Use pb-32 (or a CSS variable derived from the bar height) plus env(safe-area-inset-bottom) on the scroll container.
rules.message: Insufficient bottom padding (pb-16/pb-20/pb-24) for a fixed bottom bar. Use pb-32 plus safe-area-inset-bottom.

rules.title: Horizontal crowding on mobile cards (< 640px)
rules.signature: A justify-between flex row packing three or more complex nodes (icon + category + account + badge + amount) without truncate or wrap.
rules.impact: Long titles overlap or push the amount out of a 375px viewport.
rules.fix: Enforce the two-level invariant: row 1 for identity and amount, row 2 for context chips. Add min-w-0 to flex children and collapse secondary actions into a menu.
rules.message: Mobile card flex row without min-w-0 / truncate. Risk of overflow and horizontal push at 375px.

rules.title: Micro-Jank: synchronous I/O or heavy compute per frame
rules.signature: localStorage writes or fetch() inside scroll/drag/pointermove handlers.
rules.impact: Frame rate collapses from 60 to under 15 FPS, producing visible lag during touch interaction.
rules.fix: Keep gesture state in memory and persist with a debounce on release. (Heuristic static detection: review every hit manually.)
rules.message: Synchronous I/O (localStorage/fetch) near a per-frame handler. Debounce persistence or move it to the release event.

rules.title: Sub-44px touch target
rules.signature: Interactive element with an explicit size below 36px (h-6/h-7/h-8, w-6..w-8, size-6..size-8) and no compensating padding, hit-slop or minimum size.
rules.impact: Below roughly 36px the tap target falls short of the 44x44px accessibility minimum and causes mis-taps.
rules.fix: Add min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px], padding, or a hitSlop of at least 8px per axis.
rules.message: Interactive element below 36px with no padding, hit-slop or min-size compensation. Minimum effective target is 44x44px.

rules.title: Icon-only button without an accessible name
rules.signature: Icon-only button with no aria-label, no title and no visually hidden text.
rules.impact: Screen readers announce an unnamed button, making the control unusable.
rules.fix: Add aria-label (preferred) or a visually hidden text span.
rules.message: Icon-only button without aria-label / title / sr-only text. Add an accessible name for screen readers.

rules.title: Arbitrary font size outside the canonical type scale
rules.signature: text-[Npx] with a value outside the design-system scale.
rules.impact: Typography drift: two components render the same semantic size at different pixel values.
rules.fix: Stick to the canonical scale (text-xs, text-sm, text-base, text-lg) or promote the value to a documented token.
rules.message: Arbitrary pixel font size outside the canonical Tailwind scale.

rules.title: Clickable element without tactile feedback
rules.signature: Element with onClick and cursor-pointer but no active or hover state transition.
rules.impact: Touch devices have no hover, so the user gets zero confirmation that the tap registered.
rules.fix: Add an active state such as active:scale-[0.98] or active:bg-secondary, ideally with a transition.
rules.message: Clickable element with cursor-pointer but no active/hover feedback. Add active:scale-[0.98] or active:bg-secondary.

rules.title: Monetary value without tabular numerals
rules.signature: Currency values rendered through a number/currency formatter without tabular-nums or a monospace data font.
rules.impact: Proportional digits cause horizontal micro-jumps as amounts change between renders.
rules.fix: Apply tabular-nums (or the project's monospace data token) to every numeric column.
rules.message: Currency value without tabular-nums / monospace data font. May cause horizontal text jitter.
